title: status.json of harness release (contract 1.8.0, not stable)
description: Since 1.8.0. The progress of one `harness release` run, rewritten whole at every change in out/<timestamp>-release-command/status.json, so a dashboard can show 'running: release, 14 of 25 min'. Derived from ReleaseStatus in src/local/release.ts. Not stable: it may change in a minor release.

baseline.description: The tag the candidate is judged beside.

fast.description: --fast: the report cannot be used for a go decision.

stage.description: The stage running now; null when none is.

stopped.description: Where the line stopped (jidoka), why, and the next standard step. Absent when it did not stop.

exitCode.description: Present once the run has finished.

elapsed.description: Seconds, once the stage has ended. While it runs: now minus startedAt.

expected.description: The plan's estimate in seconds; never a timeout.
